title: AAPS 3.2.0 dev-i is not uploading to NS smoothed values from G7 patched app.
symptom: After switching from BYODA G6 to the patched G7 app, AAPS uploads raw glucose values to Nightscout instead of smoothed values.
cause: AAPS does not modify BG values; smoothing is done only for internal use and rendering, and original values are kept in the database.
evidence_quote: this is by design. AAPS doesn't modify BG values. But it can does smoothing for internal use and rendering
